text_block_list.text:
If I stumble here... how am I supposed to
ever...
catch up...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Don't give up? Just saying that won't
change
anything...

continue to

text_block_list.text: I sense something brushing against my back...

text_block_list.text:
I feel as if I've come into contact with
its 
emotions. They urge me to hurry after
Manhattan
Cafe.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As if to reflect the tone of her words,
the air in
the room grows a little chilly...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...I need to aim for the top... and keep
moving

text_block_list.text:
...I must be hearing things.
I feel like it's
a sign

text_block_list.text:

spare,
it's time to start planning for the
next race.
